decision.explanation: Both answers are valid and refer to distinct individuals named George Grimes. The first refers to George Grimes (June 29, 1877 – August 10, 1929), a political figure in Newfoundland, as stated in D1S2 and D1S4. The second refers to George Grimes (17 December 1835 – 28 January 1910), a Queensland politician, as stated in D2S2. Since both are legitimate and distinct referents under the same name, their respective birth dates and places are preserved.
